race.comment: ALABAMA CHARM (7) frustrating mare unlucky not to have the Maiden victory out of the way. Resumed over the unsuitable 1100m with a fast finishing second at Nowra with the 61.5kg. Ready for this trip and further and can finish over the top of these. HELLO G'DAY (13) shapes as the main danger after she ran on late at her first outing with a respectable fourth over 1200m at Wyong. Has further improvement and will relish the extra ground. RIVER JORDAN (5) Street Boss gelding who returns after a six-and-a-half months spell. Started hard in the market on debut with a fast finishing  second over 1150m at Beaumont (Newcastle) last February. Fitted with the two sharp trials and the lugging bit goes on from the good gate. SYLVAN (11) well bred gelding who warmed up late with a handy fifth over 1250m at Gunnedah. Has the awkward gate to deal with and the extra trip can see him run into the minor money.
